raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "perl-if" %}
{% set version = "0.0608" %}
{% set sha256 = "37206e10919c4d99273020008a3581bf0947d364e859b8966521c3145b4b3700" %}

package:
  name: {{ name }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://cpan.metacpan.org/authors/id/X/XS/XSAWYERX/if-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: {{ sha256 }}

build:
  noarch: generic
  number: 0
  script:
    - perl Makefile.PL INSTALLDIRS=vendor NO_PERLLOCAL=1 NO_PACKLIST=1
    - make
    - make test
    - make install VERBINST=1

requirements:
  build:
    - make
  host:
    - perl
    - perl-extutils-makemaker
  run:
    - perl

test:
  imports:
    - if ()

about:
  home: https://metacpan.org/dist/if
  license: GPL-1.0-or-later OR Artistic-1.0-Perl
  license_family: OTHER
  summary: 'use a Perl module if a condition holds'
  license_file:
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - cbrueffer
